title: Quality Inspector
summary: Own the standard we sell on. Every part we dispatch is inspected against the customer drawing — this role is why our customers keep re-ordering.
responsibilities: Perform incoming, in-process and final inspection against customer drawings
Carry out first-article approval at every production setup
Use height gauges, verniers, micrometers, dial gauges, plug and ring gauges and the surface plate
Record inspection results and prepare dimensional reports for dispatch
Raise non-conformances and support root-cause investigation with production and the tool room
requirements: ITI / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
Experience inspecting sheet-metal, tubular or machined components
Confident reading engineering drawings, tolerances and GD&T
Familiarity with an ISO 9001 quality system and its documentation
Careful, methodical and willing to stop a batch when something is wrong
